title: Phase 1: Admin Dashboard — Analytics & Course Content Management

stories.title: Database migration and lastLoginAt tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Flyway migration V9__add_analytics_support.sql exists at backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/
Migration adds last_login_at TIMESTAMP column to users table
Migration adds indexes: idx_payments_status_created, idx_enrollments_course_status, idx_enrollments_enrolled_at, idx_users_created_at, idx_users_role, idx_lesson_enrollments_lesson_completed
User.java has lastLoginAt LocalDateTime field
AuthService.login() updates lastLoginAt on successful login
AuthService.authenticateWithGoogle() updates lastLoginAt on successful login
application.properties has jakarta.persistence.query.timeout=5000

stories.title: Analytics repository layer with aggregate queries
acceptanceCriteria: PaymentRepository has sumRevenueByCurrency method with @Query returning List<Object[]> (currency, sum) for COMPLETED payments in date range
PaymentRepository has findRevenueByCourseSorted method returning List<Object[]> (courseId, title, revenue, count)
PaymentRepository has findRevenueTrend method returning List<Object[]> (date, sum) grouped by date
AuthRepository has countByCreatedAtBetween method for signup counts
AuthRepository has countByLastLoginAtAfter method for active user count
AuthRepository has countByRoleGrouped method returning List<Object[]> (role, count)
EnrollmentRepository has findCoursePopularity method returning List<Object[]> (courseId, title, enrollCount, completedCount, avgProgress)
EnrollmentRepository has findCompletionStatsByCourse method
LessonEnrollmentRepository has findLessonCompletionRatesByCourse method

stories.title: Analytics service, controller and DTOs
acceptanceCriteria: AdminAnalyticsController exists at features/admin/analytics/ with @PreAuthorize hasRole ADMIN
GET /api/admin/analytics/overview endpoint returns AnalyticsOverviewResponse
GET /api/admin/analytics/revenue endpoint accepts from, to, granularity params and returns RevenueTrendResponse
GET /api/admin/analytics/revenue/by-course endpoint returns List<CourseRevenueResponse>
GET /api/admin/analytics/users endpoint returns UserAnalyticsResponse
GET /api/admin/analytics/enrollments/popular returns List<CoursePopularityResponse>
GET /api/admin/analytics/progress endpoint accepts courseId param and returns CourseProgressResponse
AdminAnalyticsService applies default date range (last 30 days) when from/to not provided
AdminAnalyticsService enforces max 12-month date range
Revenue is aggregated per currency — no cross-currency summing
All 7 DTO classes exist in features/admin/analytics/dto/

stories.title: Admin content management backend — module reorder + course duplication + bulk upload
acceptanceCriteria: AdminContentController exists at features/admin/content/ with @PreAuthorize hasRole ADMIN
PATCH /api/admin/courses/{courseId}/modules/reorder accepts ModuleReorderRequest with List<Long> moduleIds
Module reorder validates all moduleIds belong to the course and updates orderIndex sequentially
POST /api/admin/courses/{courseId}/duplicate endpoint exists
Course duplication deep-copies course -> modules -> lessons -> quizzes -> questions -> options
Duplicated course title is '[Original] (Copy)', active=false, ownerUserId=admin's userId
Video S3 keys are referenced (shared) in duplicated lessons, not re-uploaded
POST /api/admin/modules/{moduleId}/lessons/bulk-upload accepts multipart files (max 20)
Bulk upload creates one lesson per file with title from filename, type=VIDEO, sequential orderIndex
Bulk upload is atomic — all succeed or all fail via @Transactional

Dashboard has a course popularity chart component
